claims.text: Google requires a reply to Business Profile messages within 24 hours and can deactivate chat for repeated non-response
A business's average response time is shown publicly to customers on the listing
24 hours is slow for urgent local searches; faster response is the real goal
A welcome message with a qualifying question holds a lead until the owner can respond personally

disclosure: Illustrative estimates only, not guaranteed results

claims.text: The Revenue Calculator takes four inputs: monthly leads, close rate, average job value, and average response time
It outputs revenue per lead, modeled monthly follow-up gap, and three separate 10% annual scenarios
The tool is free with no stated signup requirement
Responding in under five minutes outperforms slower response windows

disclosure: General pattern based on common follow-up behavior, not a controlled study.

claims.text: Repeating the same follow-up channel (three calls to the same number) often fails because it reaches the same attention gap each time.
Switching channels (call, text, email, video) after each missed touch reaches a different kind of attention and improves the odds of a response.
